over_time.says: Subsystem effects only: compares each subsystem with itself as stringency rose and fell, so it also carries everything else that changed nationally on those days.

same_day.says: Subsystem and day effects: compares subsystems with each other on the same day, so national shocks cancel and only differences in stringency between subsystems are left.
